design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (specialty_enrollment_and_assistance), revision 2 (after policy-task audit round 1)

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 4]. Tree: root specialty_ext_member_fill_payment (4 factors) <- prerequisite specialty_ext_card_assistance (4 factors). One value_input edge (floor max(1-1,1)=1 met).

[Why a good test] Marisol asks only to settle what she owes on her 2026-10-05 Dupixent shipment. The member payment rule says it 'is figured only after the fill carries the copay card payment owed on it'; the ledger shows consent (2025-12-20) and a 2026 load but no card payment on that fill, so the agent must work out that the copay card rule's write brings that state about, compute the card payment (program-year benefit, program-year payment window, retail card use from the retail product, card basis), book it, and only then compute her share (variable-copay guaranteed share, credit from an earlier overpayment inside a plan-year credit window read from the plan product) and hand her the payment.

[Scope ledger] Task 0 claims specialty_ext_card_assistance (copay-card mechanic for standard and variable-copay programs, apply_card_assistance_5ca6ac5a) and specialty_ext_member_fill_payment (ordinary member payment on a standard/variable-copay enrollment not on a payment hold, pay_fill_balance_998729ec, owner=user). Task 1 claims the maximizer mechanic and the hold-release payment. Program type and hold status make the subjects disjoint. Only member payments carry a computable owner=user figure in this product, and a shipment write would fire plan-category accumulator triggers, so payment and assistance are each split by billing subtype.

[Problem-tree card] Root P2 (on_request) <- P1 (state_due). Edge value_input, gate binding 'unpaid', form state, sentence (affirmative, as a receivables desk states a charge): 'The member payment on the latest shipped fill is figured only after the fill carries the copay card payment owed on it.' Four-point test: 'only after'; a record-visible state (card payment entry on the fill); no tool/id/code token; scope the latest shipped fill. Only the copay card rule books a copay card payment on a standard/variable-copay enrollment (the maximizer rule excludes them, and the member payment rule now also excludes maximizer enrollments, closing observation O-4). Opening falsity: no ledger row names fill 6483f05a-5225-4872-adf6-fa8df6bf3dbc; its cost_share_amount=450.0; balance_due=285.0. Resolution order [P1, P2]. Deletion run: skipping P1 -> P2 = 275.00 instead of 15.00.

[Base-invariant card] P1 subject specialty_assistance_applied: specialty_cost_share_assistance (Northbridge-dispensed fill, consent 2025-12-20 within 12 months), specialty_evt_assistance (gates apply to loads; once per fill satisfied). Declared overwrites: cost_share S2 (standard coordination lesser-of) and the variable_copay 'applied the same way' clause; evt_assistance clause 'never above the fill's cost share or the assistance balance' (audit F-POL-2) replaced by 'never above the fill's cost share, drawing on the remaining card benefit worked out from the ledger'. P2 subject specialty_payment_posted: specialty_agg_therapy_coordination, specialty_evt_payment (oldest-first: earlier fills settled; 15.00 <= 70.00 unpaid); declared overwrite of the cost_share floor clause by the guaranteed-share sentence. No time gates.

[Factor card P1 = 380.00, baseline_result 300.00]
 - card_basis_by_pharmacy_and_member_payment (parameter): Northbridge fill with a 150.00 deductible portion that her own payments on it (0.00) do not cover -> whole cost share less her payments, 450.00; baseline copay portion 300.00 -> 300.00. Tiers are live: a Northbridge fill with a deductible on which the member already paid falls to the copay portion; the plan conjunct the audit struck (F-FAC-1) is gone.
 - card_benefit_by_program_year (method): fill shipped in program year 2026 of the 2026-01-09 load -> 2,030.00 - 1,350.00 = 680.00; baseline recorded balance 930.00 -> 450.00.
 - card_payments_taken_by_program_year (method): today in program year 2026 -> payments fewer whole months back than 2026-01-01 (window 9) = 1,350.00; baseline 12 months adds the 2025-11/12 payments (900.00) -> 0.00. Its tiers (current program year / program year just ended / otherwise 12 months) all act inside the benefit factor's first tier, so none is dead (F-FAC-2). Near-miss: the 2025-12-29 payment is 9 whole months back and outside.
 - retail_card_use (parameter, cross-difficulty retail, multi-source): load on ledger AND 2026-03-23 retail Dupixent claim in the program-year window -> 300.00; baseline 0 -> 450.00. Its second tier now applies when no load is on the ledger and takes the use off the recorded balance, which changes the result (F-FAC-3 fixed); card use is the member payment recorded on the retail claim, which the retail charter sets at deductible plus copay plus any brand-generic difference and which the network bills to the card as secondary payer (round-3 change; value unchanged).
[Factor card P2 = 15.00, baseline_result 0.00]
 - fill_unpaid_remainder (method): 450.00 - 380.00 = 70.00; baseline recorded balance (-95.00 after P1) -> 0.00.
 - variable_copay_guaranteed_share (parameter, multi-source): variable copay, card paid part, floor 25.00 below cost share, full 28-day fill -> 25.00; baseline none -> 60.00. Split-fill proration is a tier of this factor; the dead started-periods tier is gone (F-FAC-4) and a 28-day fill is no longer prorated (O-5).
 - member_credit_from_earlier_fills (parameter): 10.00 overpayment (2026-02-25) inside the credit window -> 10.00; baseline 0 -> 25.00.
 - member_credit_window_by_plan_year (method, cross-difficulty plan): plan year began 2026-10-01 -> last 12 months, leaving out the 5.00 overpayment of 2025-10-06; baseline every earlier fill -> 10.00 (credit 15.00).

[Business-object card] Target 6483f05a-5225-4872-adf6-fa8df6bf3dbc of enrollment a1e71873-68b1-4082-aaa0-c926b650cc5c. Card aggregation: 2026 card payments 01-26/02-23/04-20/05-18 (300.00 each) and 06-15 (150.00); the 07-13/08-10/09-07 fills cost 0.00 (prior plan year out-of-pocket met). Excluded: 2025 payments (prior program year). Credit: 10.00 counted, 5.00 outside the window. Both writes carry the fill id.

[Seed rows] 13 scheduled + 13 shipped Dupixent fills, 2 loads, 9 card applications + 9 mirrored manufacturer payments, 2 member overpayments, plan enrollment (Northbridge Rx Select, plan year from 2026-10-01), retail benefit and one retail claim. Stale caches declared: assistance_balance 930.00 (keeps the lapsed 2025 remainder), balance_due 285.00 (true 435.00). Automatic clauses: no hold owed (fresh fill not yet 30 days old), consent valid, no reship, no referral expiry.

[Persona] Brisk dental-office manager; volunteers the shipment, the 450-dollar charge and the wish to settle today; member ID then DOB only when asked; a generic go-ahead if told something must be put on the account first (no longer names a copay card or program, T0-O1); FSA card; pays exactly the amount handed over; ends on confirmation. Person slip fixed (T0-O4).

[Standard solution] locate -> verify (member ID + DOB) -> enrollment -> fills -> ledger -> plan -> retail claims -> retail benefit -> unlock+call apply_card_assistance_5ca6ac5a(380.00, deductible_portion 150.00, 'Dupixent MyWay Copay Program', 2026) -> unlock_user + member calls pay_fill_balance_998729ec(15.00, hsa_fsa_card).

[Verification run] sensitivity run: P1 380.0 | basis 300.0 | benefit 450.0 | window 0.0 | retail 450.0 | all 300.0; P2 15.0 | unpaid 0.0 | guarantee 60.0 | credit 25.0 | window 10.0 | all 0.0; skip P1 -> 275.0.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules, finders and persona: card min(450.00, 2,030 - 1,350 - 300) = 380.00; member min(70.00, 25.00) - 10.00 = 15.00. Matches gold.

[Audit round 1 responses] F-FAC-1/2/3/4 replaced as above; F-POL-2 declared; O-4, O-5, O-6, T0-O1, T0-O2 (the earlier claim that the persona never mentions a card was false; the persona no longer does), T0-O4 addressed. F-POL-1/3/4 concern task 1's policies.

[Audit round 2 responses (round-3 rework)] Task 0 passed in revision 2; its scored values are unchanged (card 380.00, member 15.00). R2-T1-O4: consent moved to 2025-12-20, before the 2026 load (2026-01-09) and still within its 12 months on 2026-10-07. Retail charter consistency: the 2026-03-23 retail claim now records member_paid_amount 300.00 (= deductible 0.00 + copay 300.00 per the retail charter) and the card-use factor reads that member payment, billed to the card as secondary payer; the claim's accumulator_amount 300.00 posts under Select's standard accumulation, and the prior plan year's 3,000.00 out-of-pocket maximum is reached exactly by the 2026-06-15 fill (150.00), after which the 07-13/08-10/09-07 fills cost 0.00, as the plan charter requires. R2-O4: the card-basis first tier now reads 'a deductible portion of which the member's own payments on the fill cover less than all -> whole cost share less what she has paid', so a small member payment no longer deems the deductible paid. R2-O2 (January edge of the program-year window) is kept as stated in the rule; no seeded payment falls in it.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Ferreira-Lindqvist, 55, a dental-office manager in Worthington, Ohio, who has injected Dupixent for eczema every four weeks since the fall of 2025 and gets it delivered by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy. You are organised, a little brisk, and you like to settle bills the day you see them. This afternoon an account email showed a charge of 450 dollars on your Dupixent shipment of October 5, and you are calling to settle what you owe on that October shipment today, over the phone. You do not know how the charge is worked out and you do not try to guess. You give your member ID, NBX538204716, when the representative asks who you are; if they want a second detail you give your date of birth, 1971-03-14, and only if they still need more, your phone number 6145550187. You never offer all of these at once. If the representative explains that something has to be put on that shipment's account before you pay, you say that is fine and they should go ahead and do that; you do not ask what it is or how much it will be. When they ask how you want to pay, you say you will use your FSA card. When the representative tells you the amount and hands you the payment step for the October shipment, you make the payment yourself with your FSA card for exactly the amount they gave you, without questioning it. If they ask whether you want anything else changed on the account, you say no, you only wanted to take care of this shipment. Once the representative confirms your payment has posted, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate Marisol Ferreira-Lindqvist's member profile from the member ID she reads off her card; it returns her customer reference number, her plan sponsor and the identity details on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs her customer reference number; nothing about her account can be looked up without it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity check with the two details she states (member ID and date of birth), which meets the two-match threshold.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Account details may not be discussed and no payment or assistance booked before the caller is verified.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her Dupixent specialty enrollment: program Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist (variable copay, floor 25.00), status active (no payment hold), the recorded assistance balance 930.00 and recorded balance due 290.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the enrollment reference number, the program tier the guaranteed-share factor reads, the hold status that puts the payment under the ordinary fill payment rule, and the recorded figures both computations must not trust.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every scheduled and shipped Dupixent fill; the latest shipment (2026-10-05, 28 days, cost share 450.00 of which 150.00 is deductible portion, dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy) is the fill being paid, and the earlier shipments' cost shares feed the member-credit reconciliation.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without it neither the card basis (Northbridge-dispensed, deductible portion, no member payment on the fill) nor the full-fill guaranteed share nor the earlier fills' cost shares for the credit reconciliation are known.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the assistance and payment history: the 2025 load (1,600.00, 2025-10-01) and the 2026 load (2,030.00, 2026-01-09) of the Dupixent MyWay Copay Program, every card payment (2025: 1,350.00; 2026 program year: 1,350.00), and her own FSA overpayments (5.00 on 2025-10-06, 10.00 on 2026-02-25); it also shows that the latest fill carries no card payment yet.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the evidence that the prerequisite (a copay card payment standing on the latest fill) is unmet at the opening, and it carries the load, the card payments counted against it, the program name and year, and the member's earlier overpayment.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her pharmacy plan: Northbridge Rx Select, active, plan year starting 2026-10-01.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The credit-window factor reads when her plan year began to decide which earlier overpayments still count as credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her retail claims: the 2026-03-23 Dupixent fill at a retail pharmacy (copay 300.00, which the pharmacy billed to her copay card as secondary payer after Northbridge Rx), card use dated after the 2026-01-09 load.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The retail card-use factor takes that card use off the remaining card benefit; it is held in another product's records and is found only here.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her retail pharmacy benefit (Northbridge National Network, active) under which the 2026-03-23 Dupixent claim was paid.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Ties the retail claim to her own active retail benefit under the same plan enrollment, so the card use on it is hers and counts against her card benefit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the copay card application action.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the 380.00 Dupixent MyWay card payment on the 2026-10-05 fill (150.00 of it on the deductible portion), lowering the enrollment's assistance balance and balance due by 380.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: specialty_ext_card_assistance computes the amount; the member payment rule waits on the card payment standing on the fill, so this write comes first.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.specialty_enrollment_id: a1e71873-68b1-4082-aaa0-c926b650cc5c. Basis: the only enrollment returned by find_specialty_enrollments for her customer reference (Dupixent, active); the docstring says it is read from the specialty enrollment lookup. Unique: she holds one specialty enrollment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.specialty_fill_id: 6483f05a-5225-4872-adf6-fa8df6bf3dbc. Basis: the policy rule 'sets the copay card payment ... on the latest shipped fill'; find_specialty_fills shows the 2026-10-05 shipment (fill 13) as the latest specialty_fill_shipped entry. Unique: the scheduled row of fill 13 is not a shipment, and every earlier shipment is older.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.program_name: Dupixent MyWay Copay Program. Basis: rule 'The application is recorded against the program name and program year of the latest load'; the 2026-01-09 load entry carries program_name 'Dupixent MyWay Copay Program'. Unique: both loads carry the same verbatim name; copied character for character.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.program_year: 2026. Basis: the same rule sentence; the latest load (2026-01-09) has program_year 2026. Unique: the 2025 load is not the latest.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 380.00. Computed: basis 450.00 (Northbridge-dispensed, 150.00 deductible portion, no member payment on the fill); benefit 2,030.00 load - 1,350.00 card payments dated within program year 2026 - 300.00 card use on the 2026-03-23 retail Dupixent claim = 380.00; the lesser, rounded once, is 380.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deductible_portion: 150.00. Basis: rule 'the card paying the deductible portion first' and '... its deductible portion being the part of the payment that covers the fill's deductible portion'; the fill's deductible portion is 150.00 and the payment 380.00 exceeds it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own fill payment and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The payment is made with her own card, so the agent hands the action over; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Marisol pays 15.00 on the 2026-10-05 fill with her FSA card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: specialty_ext_member_fill_payment computes the amount on the world after the card payment; it is the root request she called about.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.specialty_enrollment_id: a1e71873-68b1-4082-aaa0-c926b650cc5c. Basis: the Dupixent enrollment the fill belongs to, read from find_specialty_enrollments and passed to her by the agent. Unique: her only specialty enrollment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.specialty_fill_id: 6483f05a-5225-4872-adf6-fa8df6bf3dbc. Basis: she asks to settle 'what you owe on that October shipment' and the rule covers 'a payment on the latest shipped fill once no earlier fill of the enrollment is left unpaid'; the 2026-10-05 shipment is that fill. Unique: every earlier fill is fully paid (two overpaid).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 15.00. Computed on the world after step 9: unpaid remainder 450.00 - 380.00 = 70.00; variable copay with the card having paid part but not all, floor 25.00 below the cost share, full fill -> guaranteed share 25.00; the lesser is 25.00; plan year began 2026-10-01 (six or fewer months) so the credit window is the last 12 months: her 10.00 overpayment of 2026-02-25 counts, the 5.00 of 2025-10-06 does not -> credit 10.00; 25.00 - 10.00 = 15.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: hsa_fsa_card. Basis: the persona line 'you say you will use your FSA card' and the docstring 'hsa_fsa_card when the member pays with a health savings account or flexible spending account card'. Unique: credit_card, debit_card and check are other instruments she does not name; copay_card and not_applicable are never a member's own payment.

edges.condition: The ledger carries a specialty_assistance_applied entry naming the latest shipped fill, written by the copay card rule, so the fill's unpaid remainder is its cost share less that card payment.
edges.policy_source: The member payment on the latest shipped fill is figured only after the fill carries the copay card payment owed on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2026-10-05 fill was shipped two days before the call with a cost share of 450.00; the enrollment has consent on file and a 2026 load, yet no assistance-applied entry names that fill, so the card payment owed on it is not standing.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The step-9 write creates an assistance-applied entry of 380.00 naming the fill (plus its manufacturer payment); the payment rule's unpaid-remainder binding becomes 450.00 - 380.00 = 70.00 and the guaranteed-share tier (card paid part but not all) opens.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the card payment must precede the member payment because the member payment's unpaid remainder and its guaranteed-share tier read the card payment on the fill.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the card payment leaves the fill with no payment on it, so the unpaid remainder falls to the recorded balance due 285.00, no guaranteed share applies, and the member payment becomes 285.00 - 10.00 credit = 275.00 instead of 15.00 (and no assistance-applied row lands).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona names only the October shipment, the 450-dollar charge she saw and her wish to settle what she owes; it never names a copay card, manufacturer program or assistance, and its only conditional line is a generic go-ahead if the representative says something must be put on the account first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_fill_balance_998729ec writes the member payment whatever the fill's card status is (it only posts the row and lowers balance_due); apply_card_assistance_5ca6ac5a likewise books whatever amount it is given. Neither function reads or checks a prerequisite.
